mainText:
Good morning. Weather in Prishtina: -3 degrees now, clear sky. Next 24 hours: high 6, low -3.

Former British prime minister Boris Johnson has urged European nations to send troops to Ukraine, even before Russia announces a cease-fire, sparking debate over the proposal's realism.

Nigel Farage, leader of Reform UK, said he may ask French far-right leader Marine Le Pen to help block any move to bring the United Kingdom back into the European Union.

Fuel prices in Switzerland fell as gasoline and diesel were reduced by six cents per litre, providing relief after weeks of higher costs.

NVIDIA, founded in 1993 by three engineers, has grown from a graphics-chip maker into a leading artificial-intelligence powerhouse, highlighted by the recent story of a Californian restaurant using its AI technology.

In Prizren, Kosovo, the retrial of Sead Halilaj for the murder of 19-year-old I.K. continued, with prosecutors noting the victim suffered nine cutting and stabbing wounds.
